**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 21:54
- [USER] User asked for an explanation of the plot of Death Stranding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Death Stranding is an action game developed by Kojima Productions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The protagonist, Sam Porter Bridges, is a porter for an organization known as Bridges.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The organization aims to reconnect isolated cities across the United States following a mysterious event known as the "Death Stranding."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Death Stranding event caused supernatural creatures to appear and caused widespread death and destruction.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As Sam, the player must travel across the country, delivering packages and supplies to various outposts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The player must avoid hostile creatures and hostile human factions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The player uncovers a conspiracy involving a mysterious figure known as "Higgs" and a shadowy organization known as the "Ghosts."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ultimately, the player must make difficult choices that will affect the fate of humanity.
- [USER] User asked for an explanation of the bridge babies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In Death Stranding, "Bridge Babies" are infants connected to a device called the "Chiral Bridge."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Chiral Bridge allows them to sense and detect "Beached Things" (BTs) and other supernatural phenomena.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Bridge Babies are used by the organization known as "Bridges" to help locate and avoid BTs during delivery missions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is revealed that Bridge Babies are actually stillborn children of women who were pregnant at the time of the Death Stranding event.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Chiral Bridge technology was developed to keep the Bridge Babies alive and connected to the world of the living.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The use of Bridge Babies is morally and ethically controversial and is a central theme throughout the game.
- [USER] User expressed confusion about the depiction of babies being shown down people's throats.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bridge Babies are carried in special containers called "Incubators" worn on the back of the Porter.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Porter can communicate with the Bridge Baby via a umbilical cord-like structure.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Incubator contains a life support system that keeps the baby alive.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The game depicts the Bridge Babies as precious and fragile, requiring protection during delivery missions.
